mapper.select: SELECT id, storage_no, purchase_id, order_no, apply_no, storage_date, storage_status, operator_id, operator_name, total_amount, remark, create_user, create_time, update_time FROM asset_in_storage WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, storage_no, purchase_id, order_no, apply_no, storage_date, storage_status, operator_id, operator_name, total_amount, remark, create_user, create_time, update_time FROM asset_in_storage WHERE storage_no = #{storageNo}

SELECT id, storage_no, purchase_id, order_no, apply_no, storage_date, storage_status, operator_id, operator_name, total_amount, remark, create_user, create_time, update_time FROM asset_in_storage WHERE purchase_id = #{purchaseId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT id, storage_no, purchase_id, order_no, apply_no, storage_date, storage_status, operator_id, operator_name, total_amount, remark, create_user, create_time, update_time FROM asset_in_storage WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT MAX(storage_no) FROM asset_in_storage WHERE storage_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO asset_in_storage (storage_no, purchase_id, order_no, apply_no, storage_date, storage_status, operator_id, operator_name, total_amount, remark, create_user) VALUES (#{storageNo}, #{purchaseId}, #{orderNo}, #{applyNo}, #{storageDate}, #{storageStatus}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{totalAmount}, #{remark}, #{createUser})
